changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A workspace is a team's or a person's own space (KR-06, ADR 0126). Every existing workspace is a team's. A personal space names its owner and has the slug me-- plus 16 base32 characters, which no team slug can take. Its kind and owner never change, it never publishes activity, and its one member is the owner without an admin role, so no grant of a role can let another account in.
